The commentary of al-Tabari (Jami al-Bayan) on surah 110, verses 1–3:

The interpretation of His saying, exalted be His praise and sanctified be His names: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest (1) And you see the people entering into the religion of God in multitudes (2) So glorify the praise of your Lord and seek His forgiveness; indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance (3)﴾.

He, may His remembrance be exalted, says to His Prophet Muhammad ﷺ: When there comes to you, O Muhammad, the help of God over your people from Quraysh, and the conquest, which is the conquest of Makkah, ﴿and you see the people﴾ from the various kinds and tribes of the Arabs, among them the people of Yemen and the tribes of Nizar, ﴿entering into the religion of God in multitudes﴾. He says: into the religion of God with which He sent you, and obedience to you, to which He called them, in multitudes, meaning: in groups, group after group.

The people of interpretation (ahl al-ta'wil) have said something similar to what we have said regarding this.

Mention of those who said what we have said concerning His saying: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾:

• Al-Harith related to me, he said: Al-Hasan related to us, he said: Warqa' related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, regarding the words of God: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾: the conquest of Makkah.

• Yunus related to me, he said: Ibn Wahb informed us, he said: Ibn Zayd said, regarding the words of God: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾: the help came when God granted him victory and supported him.

• Isma'il ibn Musa related to me, he said: al-Husayn ibn Isa al-Hanafi informed us, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Hazim, from Ibn Abbas, who said: While the Messenger of God ﷺ was in Madinah, he said: "Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, the help of God and the conquest have come, the people of Yemen have come." It was said: O Messenger of God, and who are the people of Yemen? He said: "A people whose hearts are tender, whose natures are gentle; faith is Yamani, understanding is Yamani, and wisdom is Yamani."

• Ibn al-Muthanna related to us, he said: Abd al-A'la related to me, he said: Dawud related to us, from Amir, from Masruq, from Aisha, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ used to frequently say: "Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi, astaghfir Allah wa atubu ilayhi." She said: I said: O Messenger of God, I see you frequently saying: "Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi, astaghfir Allah wa atubu ilayhi." He said: "My Lord informed me that I would see a sign in my Ummah, and when I see it, I should frequently say: Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi, and seek His forgiveness and repent to Him. And I have seen it: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾, the conquest of Makkah, ﴿and you see the people entering into the religion of God in multitudes, so glorify the praise of your Lord and seek His forgiveness; indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance﴾."

• Ibn Wakf'i related to us, he said: Abd al-A'la related to us, he said: Dawud related to us, from al-Sha'bi, from Masruq, from Aisha, from the Prophet ﷺ, similarly.

• Ibn al-Muthanna related to us, he said: Abd al-Wahhab related to us, he said: Dawud related to us, from Amir, from Aisha, who said: The Prophet of God ﷺ used to frequently say before his death: Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi, and then he mentioned something similar.

• Ishaq ibn Shahin related to me, he said: Khalid related to us, from Dawud, from Amir, from Masruq, from Aisha, from the Prophet ﷺ, similarly.

• Ibn Abd al-A'la related to us, he said: Ibn Thawr related to us, from Ma'mar, from Ikrimah, who said: When ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾ was revealed, the Prophet ﷺ said: "The help of God and the conquest have come, and the people of Yemen have come." They said: O Prophet of God, and who are the people of Yemen? He said: "Tender are their hearts, gentle are their natures; faith is Yamani, and wisdom is Yamani." As for His saying ﴿in multitudes﴾, its meaning has already been mentioned among the sayings of the people of interpretation.

• Al-Harith related to me, he said: Bishr related to us, he said: Yazid related to us, he said: al-Hasan related to us, he said: Warqa' related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, regarding ﴿in the religion of God in multitudes﴾, he said: groups upon groups.

* *

As for His saying: ﴿So glorify the praise of your Lord﴾

It means: glorify your Lord and magnify Him with His praise and thanks, for what He has fulfilled for you of His promise, for indeed you will then be joined to Him, and will taste what those before you of His messengers tasted of death.

The people of interpretation have said something similar to what we have said regarding this.

Mention of those who said that:

• Ibn Bashshar related to us, he said: Abd al-Rahman related to us, he said: Sufyan related to us, from Habib, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, that Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, asked them about the words of God Most High: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾. They said: the conquest of cities and palaces. He said: And what do you say, O son of Ibn Abbas? I said: It is a parable struck for Muhammad ﷺ, his own death was announced to him.

• Ibn Bashshar related to us, he said: Muhammad ibn Ja'far related to us, he said: Shu'bah related to us, from Abu Bishr, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, that Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, used to bring him close, and Abd al-Rahman said to him: We have sons like him. Umar said: He is from where you know. He said: Umar asked him about the words of God: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾, the surah. Ibn Abbas said: Its term, God made him know it. Umar said: I know nothing of it except what you know.

• Ibn Humayd related to us, he said: Mihran related to us, from Sufyan, from Asim, from Abu Razin, from Ibn Abbas, who said: Umar, may Allah be pleased with him, said: What is it? Meaning ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾. Ibn Abbas said: ﴿When there comes the help of God﴾ until he reached: ﴿and seek His forgiveness﴾, that you are dying, ﴿indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance﴾. Umar said: We know nothing of it except what you have said.

• He said: Mihran related to us, from Sufyan, from Asim, from Abu Razin, from Ibn Abbas, who said: When ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾ was revealed, the Prophet knew that his own self had been announced to him, so it was said to him: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest...﴾ to the end of the surah.

• Abu Kurayb and Ibn Waki' related to us, they said: Ibn Fudayl related to us, from Ata' ibn al-Sa'ib, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, who said: When ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾ was revealed, the Messenger of God ﷺ said: "My self has been announced to me, as if I am taken in that year."

• Muhammad ibn Sa'd related to me, he said: My father related to me, he said: My paternal uncle related to me, he said: My father related to me, from his father, from Ibn Abbas, regarding His saying: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾, he said: That is when his own self was announced to him. He says: when ﴿you see the people entering into the religion of God in multitudes﴾, meaning the Islam of the people, he says: then that is when your term has come, ﴿so glorify the praise of your Lord and seek His forgiveness; indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance﴾.

• Abu al-Sa'ib and Sa'id ibn Yahya al-Umawi related to me, they said: Abu Mu'awiyah related to us, from al-A'mash, from Muslim, from Masruq, from Aisha, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ used to frequently say before he died: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk." She said: I said: O Messenger of God, what are these words that I see you have introduced, saying them? He said: "A sign has been made for me in my Ummah, and when I see it I say them: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾ to the end of the surah."

• Yahya ibn Ibrahim al-Mas'udi related to me, he said: My father related to me, from his father, from his grandfather, from al-A'mash, from Muslim, from Masruq, who said: Aisha said: I did not hear the Messenger of God ﷺ, since this surah ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾ was revealed to him, say before it anything but: "Subhanaka Rabbana wa bihamdika, Allahumma ighfir li."

• Ibn Waki' related to us, he said: Ibn Numayr related to us, from al-A'mash, from Muslim, from Masruq, from Aisha, from the Prophet ﷺ, the like of it.

• Ibn Waki' related to us, he said: Jarir related to us, from Mansur, from Abu al-Duha, from Masruq, from Aisha, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ used to frequently say in his bowing and prostration: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, Allahumma ighfir li," interpreting the Qur'an.

• Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim related to me, he said: IbnUlayyah related to us, from Dawud, from al-Sha'bi, Dawud said: I know it only from Masruq, and sometimes he said: from Masruq, from Aisha, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ used to frequently say: "Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi, astaghfir Allah wa atubu ilayhi." I said: You frequently say this. He said: "My Lord has informed me that I will see a sign in my Ummah, and He commanded me that when I see that sign I should glorify Him with His praise and seek His forgiveness, indeed He is ever Accepting of repentance. And I have seen it: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾."

• Abu al-Sa'ib related to us, he said: Hafs related to us, he said: Asim related to us, from al-Sha'bi, from Umm Salamah, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ, in the last of his affairs, would not stand, nor sit, nor go, nor come, without saying: "Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi." I said: O Messenger of God, you frequently say Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi, you do not go or come, nor stand or sit, without my saying: Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi. He said: "I have been commanded with it," and then he recited: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾ to the end of the surah.

• Ibn Humayd related to us, he said: Salamah related to us, he said: Ibn Ishaq related to us, from some of his companions, from Ata' ibn Yasar, who said: The surah ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾ was revealed entirely at Madinah after the conquest of Makkah and the entry of the people into the religion, announcing to him his own death.

• He said: Jarir related to us, from Mughirah, from Ziyad ibn al-Husayn, from Abu al-Aliyah, who said: When ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾ was revealed, and his own self was announced to the Prophet ﷺ, he would not rise from any gathering he sat in until he said: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk."

• He said: al-Hakam ibn Bashir related to us, he said: Amr related to us, he said: When ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾ was revealed, the Prophet ﷺ used to frequently say: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, Rabbi ighfir li wa tub alayya, innaka anta al-Tawwab al-Rahim."

• Bishr related to us, he said: Yazid related to us, he said: Sa'id related to us, from Qatadah, ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾, he recited it entirely. Ibn Abbas said: This surah is a sign and a limit which God set for His Prophet ﷺ, and announced to him his own self. Indeed, you will not live after it except a little. Qatadah said: By God, he did not live after that except a little, two years, then he passed away ﷺ.

• Ibn Humayd related to us, he said: Mihran related to us, from Abu Mu'adh Isa ibn Abi Yazid, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu Ubaydah, from Ibn Mas'ud, who said: When ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾ was revealed, he used to frequently say: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, Allahumma ighfir li, subhanaka Rabbana wa bihamdika, Allahumma ighfir li, innaka anta al-Tawwab al-Ghafur."

• It was related from al-Husayn, he said: I heard Abu Mu'adh say: Ubayd related to us, he said: I heard al-Dahhak say regarding the words of God: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾: This surah was a sign of the death of the Messenger of God ﷺ.

• Muhammad ibn Amr related to me, he said: Abu Asim related to us, he said: Isa related to us; and al-Harith related to me, he said: al-Hasan related to us, he said: Warqa' related to us, all from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, regarding the words of God: ﴿and seek His forgiveness; indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance﴾, he said: Know that you will die at that time.

* *

As for His saying: ﴿and seek His forgiveness﴾

It means: ask Him to forgive your sins.

It means: indeed He is one who returns to His servant who obeys Him, with what He loves. The pronoun in His saying "innahu" refers to God, mighty and majestic.

End of the commentary on Surah al-Nasr.

The commentary of al-Tabari (Jami al-Bayan) on surah 110, verses 1–3:

The interpretation of His saying, exalted be His praise and sanctified be His names: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest (1) And you see the people entering into the religion of God in multitudes (2) So glorify the praise of your Lord and seek His forgiveness; indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance (3)﴾.

He, may His remembrance be exalted, says to His Prophet Muhammad ﷺ: When there comes to you, O Muhammad, the help of God over your people from Quraysh, and the conquest, which is the conquest of Makkah, ﴿and you see the people﴾ from the various kinds and tribes of the Arabs, among them the people of Yemen and the tribes of Nizar, ﴿entering into the religion of God in multitudes﴾. He says: into the religion of God with which He sent you, and obedience to you, to which He called them, in multitudes, meaning: in groups, group after group.

The people of interpretation (ahl al-ta'wil) have said something similar to what we have said regarding this.

Mention of those who said what we have said concerning His saying: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾:

• Al-Harith related to me, he said: Al-Hasan related to us, he said: Warqa' related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, regarding the words of God: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾: the conquest of Makkah.

• Yunus related to me, he said: Ibn Wahb informed us, he said: Ibn Zayd said, regarding the words of God: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾: the help came when God granted him victory and supported him.

• Isma'il ibn Musa related to me, he said: al-Husayn ibn Isa al-Hanafi informed us, from Ma'mar, from al-Zuhri, from Abu Hazim, from Ibn Abbas, who said: While the Messenger of God ﷺ was in Madinah, he said: "Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, the help of God and the conquest have come, the people of Yemen have come." It was said: O Messenger of God, and who are the people of Yemen? He said: "A people whose hearts are tender, whose natures are gentle; faith is Yamani, understanding is Yamani, and wisdom is Yamani."

• Ibn al-Muthanna related to us, he said: Abd al-A'la related to me, he said: Dawud related to us, from Amir, from Masruq, from Aisha, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ used to frequently say: "Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi, astaghfir Allah wa atubu ilayhi." She said: I said: O Messenger of God, I see you frequently saying: "Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi, astaghfir Allah wa atubu ilayhi." He said: "My Lord informed me that I would see a sign in my Ummah, and when I see it, I should frequently say: Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi, and seek His forgiveness and repent to Him. And I have seen it: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾, the conquest of Makkah, ﴿and you see the people entering into the religion of God in multitudes, so glorify the praise of your Lord and seek His forgiveness; indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance﴾."

• Ibn Wakf'i related to us, he said: Abd al-A'la related to us, he said: Dawud related to us, from al-Sha'bi, from Masruq, from Aisha, from the Prophet ﷺ, similarly.

• Ibn al-Muthanna related to us, he said: Abd al-Wahhab related to us, he said: Dawud related to us, from Amir, from Aisha, who said: The Prophet of God ﷺ used to frequently say before his death: Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi, and then he mentioned something similar.

• Ishaq ibn Shahin related to me, he said: Khalid related to us, from Dawud, from Amir, from Masruq, from Aisha, from the Prophet ﷺ, similarly.

• Ibn Abd al-A'la related to us, he said: Ibn Thawr related to us, from Ma'mar, from Ikrimah, who said: When ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾ was revealed, the Prophet ﷺ said: "The help of God and the conquest have come, and the people of Yemen have come." They said: O Prophet of God, and who are the people of Yemen? He said: "Tender are their hearts, gentle are their natures; faith is Yamani, and wisdom is Yamani." As for His saying ﴿in multitudes﴾, its meaning has already been mentioned among the sayings of the people of interpretation.

• Al-Harith related to me, he said: Bishr related to us, he said: Yazid related to us, he said: al-Hasan related to us, he said: Warqa' related to us, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, regarding ﴿in the religion of God in multitudes﴾, he said: groups upon groups.

* *

As for His saying: ﴿So glorify the praise of your Lord﴾

It means: glorify your Lord and magnify Him with His praise and thanks, for what He has fulfilled for you of His promise, for indeed you will then be joined to Him, and will taste what those before you of His messengers tasted of death.

The people of interpretation have said something similar to what we have said regarding this.

Mention of those who said that:

• Ibn Bashshar related to us, he said: Abd al-Rahman related to us, he said: Sufyan related to us, from Habib, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, that Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, asked them about the words of God Most High: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾. They said: the conquest of cities and palaces. He said: And what do you say, O son of Ibn Abbas? I said: It is a parable struck for Muhammad ﷺ, his own death was announced to him.

• Ibn Bashshar related to us, he said: Muhammad ibn Ja'far related to us, he said: Shu'bah related to us, from Abu Bishr, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, that Umar ibn al-Khattab, may Allah be pleased with him, used to bring him close, and Abd al-Rahman said to him: We have sons like him. Umar said: He is from where you know. He said: Umar asked him about the words of God: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾, the surah. Ibn Abbas said: Its term, God made him know it. Umar said: I know nothing of it except what you know.

• Ibn Humayd related to us, he said: Mihran related to us, from Sufyan, from Asim, from Abu Razin, from Ibn Abbas, who said: Umar, may Allah be pleased with him, said: What is it? Meaning ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾. Ibn Abbas said: ﴿When there comes the help of God﴾ until he reached: ﴿and seek His forgiveness﴾, that you are dying, ﴿indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance﴾. Umar said: We know nothing of it except what you have said.

• He said: Mihran related to us, from Sufyan, from Asim, from Abu Razin, from Ibn Abbas, who said: When ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾ was revealed, the Prophet knew that his own self had been announced to him, so it was said to him: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest...﴾ to the end of the surah.

• Abu Kurayb and Ibn Waki' related to us, they said: Ibn Fudayl related to us, from Ata' ibn al-Sa'ib, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, who said: When ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾ was revealed, the Messenger of God ﷺ said: "My self has been announced to me, as if I am taken in that year."

• Muhammad ibn Sa'd related to me, he said: My father related to me, he said: My paternal uncle related to me, he said: My father related to me, from his father, from Ibn Abbas, regarding His saying: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾, he said: That is when his own self was announced to him. He says: when ﴿you see the people entering into the religion of God in multitudes﴾, meaning the Islam of the people, he says: then that is when your term has come, ﴿so glorify the praise of your Lord and seek His forgiveness; indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance﴾.

• Abu al-Sa'ib and Sa'id ibn Yahya al-Umawi related to me, they said: Abu Mu'awiyah related to us, from al-A'mash, from Muslim, from Masruq, from Aisha, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ used to frequently say before he died: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk." She said: I said: O Messenger of God, what are these words that I see you have introduced, saying them? He said: "A sign has been made for me in my Ummah, and when I see it I say them: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾ to the end of the surah."

• Yahya ibn Ibrahim al-Mas'udi related to me, he said: My father related to me, from his father, from his grandfather, from al-A'mash, from Muslim, from Masruq, who said: Aisha said: I did not hear the Messenger of God ﷺ, since this surah ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾ was revealed to him, say before it anything but: "Subhanaka Rabbana wa bihamdika, Allahumma ighfir li."

• Ibn Waki' related to us, he said: Ibn Numayr related to us, from al-A'mash, from Muslim, from Masruq, from Aisha, from the Prophet ﷺ, the like of it.

• Ibn Waki' related to us, he said: Jarir related to us, from Mansur, from Abu al-Duha, from Masruq, from Aisha, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ used to frequently say in his bowing and prostration: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, Allahumma ighfir li," interpreting the Qur'an.

• Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim related to me, he said: IbnUlayyah related to us, from Dawud, from al-Sha'bi, Dawud said: I know it only from Masruq, and sometimes he said: from Masruq, from Aisha, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ used to frequently say: "Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi, astaghfir Allah wa atubu ilayhi." I said: You frequently say this. He said: "My Lord has informed me that I will see a sign in my Ummah, and He commanded me that when I see that sign I should glorify Him with His praise and seek His forgiveness, indeed He is ever Accepting of repentance. And I have seen it: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾."

• Abu al-Sa'ib related to us, he said: Hafs related to us, he said: Asim related to us, from al-Sha'bi, from Umm Salamah, who said: The Messenger of God ﷺ, in the last of his affairs, would not stand, nor sit, nor go, nor come, without saying: "Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi." I said: O Messenger of God, you frequently say Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi, you do not go or come, nor stand or sit, without my saying: Subhan Allah wa bihamdihi. He said: "I have been commanded with it," and then he recited: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾ to the end of the surah.

• Ibn Humayd related to us, he said: Salamah related to us, he said: Ibn Ishaq related to us, from some of his companions, from Ata' ibn Yasar, who said: The surah ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾ was revealed entirely at Madinah after the conquest of Makkah and the entry of the people into the religion, announcing to him his own death.

• He said: Jarir related to us, from Mughirah, from Ziyad ibn al-Husayn, from Abu al-Aliyah, who said: When ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾ was revealed, and his own self was announced to the Prophet ﷺ, he would not rise from any gathering he sat in until he said: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, ashhadu an la ilaha illa anta, astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk."

• He said: al-Hakam ibn Bashir related to us, he said: Amr related to us, he said: When ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾ was revealed, the Prophet ﷺ used to frequently say: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, Rabbi ighfir li wa tub alayya, innaka anta al-Tawwab al-Rahim."

• Bishr related to us, he said: Yazid related to us, he said: Sa'id related to us, from Qatadah, ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾, he recited it entirely. Ibn Abbas said: This surah is a sign and a limit which God set for His Prophet ﷺ, and announced to him his own self. Indeed, you will not live after it except a little. Qatadah said: By God, he did not live after that except a little, two years, then he passed away ﷺ.

• Ibn Humayd related to us, he said: Mihran related to us, from Abu Mu'adh Isa ibn Abi Yazid, from Abu Ishaq, from Abu Ubaydah, from Ibn Mas'ud, who said: When ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾ was revealed, he used to frequently say: "Subhanaka Allahumma wa bihamdika, Allahumma ighfir li, subhanaka Rabbana wa bihamdika, Allahumma ighfir li, innaka anta al-Tawwab al-Ghafur."

• It was related from al-Husayn, he said: I heard Abu Mu'adh say: Ubayd related to us, he said: I heard al-Dahhak say regarding the words of God: ﴿When there comes the help of God and the conquest﴾: This surah was a sign of the death of the Messenger of God ﷺ.

• Muhammad ibn Amr related to me, he said: Abu Asim related to us, he said: Isa related to us; and al-Harith related to me, he said: al-Hasan related to us, he said: Warqa' related to us, all from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, regarding the words of God: ﴿and seek His forgiveness; indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance﴾, he said: Know that you will die at that time.

* *

As for His saying: ﴿and seek His forgiveness﴾

It means: ask Him to forgive your sins.

It means: indeed He is one who returns to His servant who obeys Him, with what He loves. The pronoun in His saying "innahu" refers to God, mighty and majestic.

End of the commentary on Surah al-Nasr.
